annotation.bound_parties_text: The specification's principal users are organizations conducting automated vehicle trials (Trialling Organizations), which it sets requirements for on collecting, storing and sharing information.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Principal users will be organizations conducting automated vehicle trials.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: PAS 1882:2021 details how information should be handled during automated vehicle trials to ensure it's collected consistently and improves the safety of UK trials.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Data collection and management for automated vehicle trials for the purpose of incident investigation. Specification
